Todos are now sorted by priority (high, med, low). Todos with the same priority keep the order they were added. Both checks pass.

I kept the existing rule that finished todos always sit below unfinished ones, so the priority sort runs separately in each group.

I rejected sorting the whole list by priority first, because a finished high-priority todo would then show above an unfinished low-priority one.
